The Message
Not a trend.
A priority.

Kingdom Over Everything is a reminder to order your life around what matters most. Matthew 6:33 puts the Kingdom and righteousness first—not as an accessory, but as the foundation.

The collection keeps the design restrained: a small K/O/E mark up front and a bold cross-backed statement on the reverse. The sand colorway stays quiet and grounded; the black edition turns the same message into a sharper statement.
